stem_book: In which of the following equilibria are Kc and Kp not equal? (a) 2NO(g) ⇌ N₂(g) + O₂(g) (b) SO₂(g) + NO₂(g) ⇌ SO₃(g) + NO(g) (c) H₂(g) + I₂(g) ⇌ 2HI(g) (d) 2C(s) + O₂(g) ⇌ 2CO(g)
reason: Print has the unbalanced '2C(s) + O₂(g) ⇌ 2CO₂(g)' (misprint for 2CO); corrected in stem_book. Either way Δn_g = 1 for (d), the others have Δn_g = 0.
work: Kp = Kc(RT)^Δn; (a),(b),(c) Δn_g = 0; (d) Δn_g = 2 − 1 = 1 ⇒ Kp ≠ Kc
